title: Spain need a draw, England need a win, and Group A3 finishes in Madrid
summary: Spain have won all five group games for 15 points and a goal difference of plus nine; England have 12 and plus 12 after beating Croatia 2-1 at Wembley on Thursday through Morgan Rogers and a Harry Kane penalty on his record 126th cap. Both are already in the quarter-finals. Spain need only a draw at the Metropolitano on Sunday evening; England must win, with a two-goal margin settling it on head-to-head goals and a one-goal win on goal difference.
